summary: Evidence verification ignores preferred passes superseded by a later failure before validating preference, allowing a newer valid non-preferred pass to decide.

schema.detail: No record or policy format changes.

rules.detail: An eligible preferred pass still wins over a newer non-preferred pass when no failure intervenes. A preferred pass shadowed by a later failure cannot block the normal newest-valid-pass fallback through its own invalidity. Existing failure timestamp and skew rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing signatures, policy inputs and command arguments remain unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the prior preference validation order; stored evidence is unchanged.
